setup.text: Choose a folder to store your notes. All notes are saved here as Markdown files, ready to open with any other tool.
setup.hint: Suggested: Documents\PinSlip (you can change this anytime)

error.serviceDown: Cannot connect to the local service: {{message}}

dialog.chooseVaultTitle: Choose where to store your notes

note.conflictTip: This note contains git conflict markers. Open it to resolve.
note.syncTipDirty: Unsynced changes — click to sync now
note.noSubfolders: No subfolders yet — create them in the main window
note.groupHandleTip: Drag to move group · double-click to name · right-click menu
note.groupHandleTipNamed: Group "{{name}}" · drag to move · double-click to rename · right-click menu

folders.deleteMoveNotes: Move notes to root, then delete

move.title: Move "{{title}}" to…
move.noFolders: No folders yet — create one at the top right

settings.title: Settings
settings.autoStartDevHint: Not changeable in dev mode; applies to the installed app
settings.quickClipboardTip: Pre-fill with clipboard text when the quick note window opens
settings.quickHint: Daily mode appends to the "Quick note YYYY-MM-DD" note
settings.trashHint: Deleted folders move to .trash; drag them back into notes/ to recover
settings.trayIconTip: Show the PinSlip icon in the system tray
settings.trayIconHint: With the tray icon off, closing all windows quits the app
settings.taskbarIconTip: Show window icons in the taskbar
settings.taskbarIconHint: When off, neither the main window nor note windows appear in the taskbar. With the tray icon also off there will be no window entry — use the shortcut or relaunch the app
settings.notePlacementHint: Beside main window: brand-new notes open next to the main window when it's visible
settings.managerThemeHint: Applies only to the main window and settings drawer; note windows and note colors are unaffected
settings.blankNoteShortcutHint: Press to create a blank note in the root folder and focus it; placement follows the new note placement option
settings.blankNoteShortcutRegisterFailed: Failed to register the shortcut: it may be used by another app or the other shortcut. Previous setting restored
settings.quickCaptureShortcutHint: Press to open the quick note window; if it conflicts with another app (e.g. Explorer's New Folder), pick another key or turn it off
settings.quickCaptureShortcutRegisterFailed: Failed to register the shortcut: it may be used by another app or the other shortcut. Previous setting restored
settings.toolbarButtonsHint: Drag to reorder: the first 8 show on the note toolbar, the rest move to the ⋯ menu; narrow windows hide buttons from the end

update.hintDev: Update checks are unavailable in dev mode
update.hintIdle: Updates are checked automatically after launch
update.hintAvailable: New version v{{version}} found, downloading in the background…
update.hintDownloaded: v{{version}} is ready and takes effect after restart
update.hintError: Check failed: {{message}}. You can download the installer manually
update.devUnsupported: Update checks are not supported in dev mode

sync.formHint: Supports HTTPS repos such as GitHub / cnb; the token is stored only in .pinslip/ inside your local vault and never uploaded
sync.syncOnChangeHint: Auto-syncs (commit+pull+push) about 2 minutes after you stop editing; the periodic cycle still runs as a fallback
sync.adoptHint: Adoption creates and commits a .pinslip-repo marker file at the repository root (any existing uncommitted changes will be committed along with it); sync then works normally
sync.divergenceInfo: Last remote commit {{time}}; {{local}} local / {{remote}} remote notes
sync.divergenceHint: "Overwrite remote" force-pushes and discards the diverged remote history; "Rebuild local" first backs up local notes/inbox/attachments to .pinslip/backups/, then replaces local content with the remote version
sync.statusHint: Changes auto-commit after 2 idle minutes and sync every {{minutes}} min; conflicts are written as standard git markers and disappear once resolved

mcp.hint: AI tools (Kimi / Claude, etc.) can search, read, write, and sync notes via MCP; the service only listens on 127.0.0.1 and is never exposed to the LAN; the browser extension also connects through this address

conflict.banner: This note has sync conflicts — resolve them and save

quick.hint: Enter to save · Ctrl+Enter to save & continue · Shift+Enter for newline · Esc to close

serverError.SYNC_URL_REQUIRED: A repository URL is required to enable sync
serverError.SYNC_LOCAL_NOT_PINSLIP_REPO: This folder is already a git repository but not a PinSlip sync repository. Please handle .git manually before configuring sync
serverError.SYNC_LOCAL_PERMISSION: No permission to read or write the sync folder. Check the folder permissions or run with appropriate privileges
serverError.SYNC_REMOTE_NOT_PINSLIP_REPO: The remote repository is not a PinSlip sync repository (missing the .pinslip-repo marker). If you intend to reuse it, commit and push the .pinslip-repo marker file from a machine that owns the repository, then retry; otherwise use an empty repository
serverError.SYNC_REMOTE_ACCESS: Cannot access the remote repository. Check the URL, username, and token
serverError.SYNC_BRANCH_NOT_FOUND: The branch does not exist on the remote. Check the branch name or use an empty repository
serverError.SYNC_UNRELATED_HISTORIES: Local and remote histories share no common ancestor and cannot be merged automatically
serverError.SYNC_DIRTY_WORKTREE: Local uncommitted changes would be overwritten by the remote. Please commit or move the file first
serverError.NOTE_NOT_FOUND: The note does not exist or has been deleted
